UPDATE tb_outbox_event t SET
t.event_type = #{eventType},
t.aggregate_id = #{aggregateId},
t.payload = #{payload},
t.status = #{status},
t.topic = #{topic},
t.message_key = #{messageKey},
t.retry_count = #{retryCount},
t.max_retry = #{maxRetry},
t.failure_reason = #{failureReason},
t.published_time = #{publishedTime},
t.updated_time = now() WHERE t.id = #{id}
